java_trace.pipe_read_single_diagram: Pipe#readSingleDiagram (Pipe.java:179-225), which feeds -pipe input to SourceStringReader. State NO_CONTENT -> START_MARK_NOT_FOUND on the first line whose String#trim is non-empty. Lines starting with '@@@format ' are consumed by manageFormat and never added. In START_MARK_NOT_FOUND, a line that startsWith("@start") at column 0 discards earlier input (sb.setLength(0)) and sets START_MARK_FOUND; expectedEnd = "@end" + group(1) when the whole line matches @start([A-Za-z]*), else "@end" (Pipe.java:194-199). In START_MARK_FOUND, a line that startsWith(expectedEnd) at column 0 sets COMPLETE (Pipe.java:203) and reading stops after appending that line, so later lines are not part of this diagram. At EOF: START_MARK_FOUND returns sb + expectedEnd (Pipe.java:219), START_MARK_NOT_FOUND returns "@startuml\n" + sb + "@enduml\n" (line 217), COMPLETE returns sb. An indented '  @enduml' or a '\\enduml' line is therefore never Pipe's end: Pipe appends its own end after it.
java_trace.block_uml_builder: BlockUmlBuilder#<init> (BlockUmlBuilder.java:88-135) tests StartUtils#isStartDirective and #isEndDirective on each line ReadFilterMergeLines returns, so on merged lines only. A raw line merged into a continued line is never a start or end directive; the block ends at the first merged result that is an end directive, and the appended Pipe end is an ordinary input line for this test.
java_trace.read_filter_merge_lines: Unchanged from round 1 (preproc2.ReadFilterMergeLines#readLine; ReadFilterQuoteComment#readLine with longComment local to each call; StringLocated#mergeEndBackslash keeps the first location; the ditaa switch is DiagramType#findStartTypes(trim).contains(DITAA) on a result line and resets on an end directive).
java_trace.tim_result_list: BlockUml passes the whole block, its start and end lines included, to TIM (TimLoader -> TContext#executeLines). The result list holds the start line, every PLAIN line (blank lines included) with its location, included-file lines with their own locations, and the end line last. Comment lines (CodeIteratorShortComment/LongComment) and directive lines (!define, !$x =, !if/!endif, !include itself, procedure definitions) produce no entry.
java_trace.uml_source_load_internal: UmlSource#loadInternal (core/UmlSource.java:118-134) with checkEndingBackslash (PSystemBuilder.java:210-212: findStartTypes(first line).contains(SEQUENCE), i.e. @startuml): over the TIM result list, a line that endsWithBackslash appends its text minus the backslash to pending; the next line that does not appends its whole text and the joined StringLocated takes that line's location. So an included 'tail \\' joins with whatever the next TIM result line is: the next main line when only directives intervene (location of that line), a blank line, or the end line ('tail @enduml', location of the end line).
java_trace.end_after_join: PSystemCommandFactory#createSystem (command/PSystemCommandFactory.java:97-109) stops at an end directive or when the iterator runs out. When the end line was joined into a message the source has no end directive and the message line is executed as a command ('tail @enduml' is the message label).
java_trace.ditaa_exemption: ReadFilterMergeLines#isDitaa: DiagramType#findStartTypes(StringUtils#trinNoTrace(line)).contains(DITAA) on a start directive turns the join off until the next end directive. findStartTypes is case-insensitive and keyed on the start directive only, so '@startditaa' is exempt and '@startuml' + 'ditaa' is not.

causal_divergence: merge_ending_backslash_lines appends '@enduml' only when no input line is_end_directive (BlockUmlBuilder's whitespace-tolerant test), so '  @enduml' after a continued line suppresses the append, the merge swallows it and the block has no end.

split_blocks (parse/mod.rs) ends a block on any raw line whose trim starts with '@end', including a line ReadFilterMergeLines merges into the previous one, so content after an indented end that Java keeps is cut off.

collapse_post_tim_ending_backslashes treats Rust's blank directive placeholders (push_directive_placeholder, the post-procedure padding) as TIM result lines, so 'tail \\' joins with an empty placeholder instead of the next main line.

The Rust parser stream has no end line, so a pending tail at the end of the list is dropped where Java joins it with the end line. The appended Pipe end is also popped from the merged lines, so no end line exists for it either.
rust_locations: crates/rustuml-parser/src/preprocess/mod.rs: new pipe_single_diagram_lines, a port of Pipe#readSingleDiagram's start and end recognition: column-0 '@start', expectedEnd from the whole-line @start([A-Za-z]*) match or '@end', column-0 startsWith(expectedEnd) completes and cuts later lines, otherwise expectedEnd (or '@enduml' when no column-0 start was seen) is appended. merge_ending_backslash_lines runs ReadFilterMergeLines over that list; the appended end stays in the merged lines (TIM sees it, as in Java) instead of being popped.

crates/rustuml-parser/src/preprocess/mod.rs + parse/mod.rs: split_blocks tests start and end directives only on raw lines that ReadFilterMergeLines reads as results; lines it merges into a continued line are block content (BlockUmlBuilder tests merged lines).

crates/rustuml-parser/src/preprocess/mod.rs: push_directive_placeholder and the post-procedure padding emit an internal placeholder value that collapse_post_tim_ending_backslashes skips (it is not a Java TIM line) and that becomes the usual empty line afterwards. Real blank lines are still lines.

crates/rustuml-parser/src/preprocess/mod.rs: PreprocessContext records the block's end line (its TIM text and diagram source line) when it ends the top-level block; collapse_post_tim_ending_backslashes joins a pending tail with it (text = pending + end text, location = end line) instead of dropping it.
